as_told.title: Star Trek inspired by Phyllis Schlemmer's channelling

plain: A researcher called Greg, on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a session held in Ossining, New York, in the mid-1970s. He says the television producer Gene Roddenberry sat with the researcher Andrija Puharich while a woman named Phyllis Schlemmer acted as the channel, a person who says she speaks messages from other beings. Greg points to a tape of the session kept in Puharich's archive, and the story matters to him because it would put a famous storyteller in the room with people who believed they were talking to non-human minds.
